description: Apparent close pairings seen from a place over a period (default 7 days, at most 31): the Moon and the planets with each other and with the bright stars near the ecliptic (Regulus, Spica, Antares, Aldebaran, Pollux…), at their closest, with where to look and whether the pair is visible (above the horizon, dark sky). With `satellite` (a NORAD number), that satellite passing near them during its passes over one day.

days.description: Length of the period in days (default 7; 1 with a satellite).

height_m.description: Observer height above sea level, m.

lang.description: Language of names and texts (default en).

satellite.description: An Earth satellite (NORAD number) to check against the Moon, planets and stars.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for local times, e.g. "Europe/Paris".

name: perigee_sky_conjunctions
title: Close pairings in the sky
